We made the following improvements to the Azure API Management service:
  • JWT token policy We added the match attribute to the claim element to enable a degree of control over how claims in the policy are matched against those in the JWT token.
  • Proxy server The Server header is stripped from responses.
  • Developer portal The Sign in and Sign up menu items on the portal are hidden when no identity providers are selected.
  • Developer portal We made a few changes to improve the usability of the documentation and console:
    • Response headers and response body are shown together in a single control
    • Request URL is back
    • Request body example, when provided, is used to populate the request body control
    • Double-clicking in text areas selects all content to simplify copying
    • Buttons are added to reveal secret values in the request
Body.Markdown:
We made the following improvements to the Azure API Management service:

JWT token policy

We added the match attribute to the claim element to enable a degree of control over how claims in the policy are matched against those in the JWT token.

Proxy server

The Server header is stripped from responses.

Developer portal

The Sign in and Sign up menu items on the portal are hidden when no identity providers are selected.

Developer portal

We made a few changes to improve the usability of the documentation and console:

Response headers and response body are shown together in a single control

Request URL is back

Request body example, when provided, is used to populate the request body control

Double-clicking in text areas selects all content to simplify copying

Buttons are added to reveal secret values in the request
